add_path_hint: Paste the path from the Explorer address bar, for example D:\Reports\Sales or \\server\share\exports. There is no system folder-picker window here: the program works without third-party libraries, and the browser does not reveal the real path to a folder. That is why the path is checked right after you paste it.
comments_kept: Your comments in the settings file are not touched by edits.
comments_lost: Warning: writing will lose the comments in the settings file.
duplicates_hint: The generator tells files apart by name, so from such a pair it will read only one file. Refine the masks or remove the extra folder.
empty_hint: Add a report and specify the folders from which the program will read files for it.
empty_title: No report is set up yet
err_bad_dashboard: The report identifier is not valid: it is empty, too long, or contains a colon or square brackets.
err_bad_index: This entry has already changed — the screen has been refreshed, try again.
err_bad_json: The program did not understand the page's request.
err_bad_mask: The mask is not valid: it is empty, too long or contains a comma (a comma separates masks).
err_bad_origin: The request did not come from the program window and was rejected.
err_bad_path: This path cannot be saved: it is empty, too long or contains a line break.
err_bad_s3_access_key: Access key ID is not filled in.
err_bad_s3_host: The storage address is not valid: remove the extras, only the server name is needed, for example storage.yandexcloud.net.
err_bad_s3_host_port: The storage address contains a port — there is a separate field for it. Leave only the server name in the address.
err_bad_s3_name: The connection name is not valid: use Latin letters and digits, up to 32 characters, no spaces.
err_bad_s3_port: The port is not valid: it is a number from 1 to 65535 (usually 443).
err_bad_s3_region: The region is not valid: it is a short word like ru-central1.
err_bad_s3_remote: Remote directory is not valid: it must start with the bucket name, for example prod-s3-nwd or prod-s3-nwd/exports.
err_bad_s3_secret: The secret is not valid: it is empty or too long.
err_bad_scenario: The scenario name is not valid: it is empty, too long or contains square brackets.
err_cred_unavailable: Windows protected storage is unavailable, and the program will not write the secret to a plain file.
err_duplicate_section: The settings file has two sections with this header, and they cannot be edited blindly. Keep one.
err_network: The program did not respond. The agent may be closed — start it and refresh the screen.
err_no_s3_secret: No secret is set for this connection — enter it and save.
err_no_section: This section is no longer in the settings file — the screen has been refreshed.
err_not_utf8: The settings file is not saved in UTF-8.
err_read_failed: The settings file cannot be read.
err_s3_failed: The storage did not respond as expected: {p1}
err_scenario_exists: This report already has a scenario with that name.
err_section_exists: This report is already in the settings.
err_too_large: The settings file is unexpectedly large — the program will not rewrite it.
err_unparsable: The settings file cannot be parsed — while it is in this state, the program does not write to it.
err_write_failed: Could not write the settings file. Check that it is not open in another program and that there is free space on the disk.
ini_absent: There is no settings file yet — it will appear as soon as you add the first report.
ini_path: The settings are in the file {p1}
masks_hint: Masks separated by commas, for example *.xlsx, Sales*.xlsb. Empty in “Take only” means “take everything”. Masks do not apply to a “file” entry — a named file is read as named.
masks_title: What to take from the folders
new_section_hint: Take the report identifier from the report's address on the platform — it is the part after /d/.
not_checked: Not checked — there was not enough time to walk the disks. Press “Check”.
partial_note: Some folders were not walked this time: network drives respond slowly. Press “Check” on the report you need.
pick_none: Nothing chosen. You can also paste the path as a string — the program will immediately show what lies at it.
probe_denied: The path exists, but there is no access to it.
probe_dir: This is a folder. Files in it: {p1}.
probe_missing: There is nothing at this path.
problem_duplicate_section: The settings file has two sections with the same header ({p1}). When read they merge into one, and editing them would have to be blind, so writing is disabled. Keep one section and refresh the screen.
problem_not_utf8: The settings file is not saved in UTF-8, and it cannot be read without corrupting letters. Re-save it in Notepad as UTF-8.
problem_read_failed: The settings file cannot be read. Check that it is not open in another program and that you have access to it.
problem_too_large: The settings file is unexpectedly large. Apparently it is not the right file under this name — the program will not rewrite it.
problem_unparsable: The settings file cannot be parsed: not a single section of the form [folders:…] was found in it. Open it in Notepad and check the headers — while the file is in this state, the program does not write to it, so as not to entrench the breakage.
reason_denied: Access denied. You do not currently have rights to this folder — ask the folder's owner to grant access.
reason_no_match: The folder exists and is readable, but no file fell under the masks. Check include and exclude.
reason_not_a_dir: The type of the path is not the declared one: a folder is written as a file or vice versa.
reason_not_found: There is no folder or file at this path. Check the spelling, the drive letter and whether the network drive is connected.
remove_confirm: Remove “{p1}” from this report's settings? The files on disk will stay in place.
s3_forget_confirm: Forget the secret of connection “{p1}”? The files and settings will stay, but downloading will stop working until you enter the secret again.
s3_ini_absent: The file {p1} does not exist yet — it will appear as soon as you save the first connection.
s3_last_pull_failed: The last attempt ({p1}) failed — the folder holds what arrived earlier.
s3_last_pull_never: Never downloaded yet — the folder has nothing from the bucket so far.
s3_name_hint: A short name in Latin letters — you will use it to call this connection in the s3-list and s3-sync commands. It cannot be changed later: the secret and the list of already downloaded files are stored under this same name.
s3_problem: Something is wrong in the agent.ini file ({p1}) — while it is in this state, the program does not write to it. Open it in Notepad and check the section headers.
s3_pull_foreign: The folder has files that the program did not bring and does not touch: {p1}.
s3_pull_running: A download is already in progress — showing its progress.
s3_pull_unsaved: Save the connection first — the program will download using the saved fields and secret.
s3_refresh_hint: When on, the report is computed on what is in the bucket right now: before every run the program fetches the fresh data into this folder itself, and if the bucket is unavailable the run stops and says so instead of computing on yesterday's files. Clear the checkbox if the connection is slow and you deliberately want to compute on what is already downloaded.
s3_remote_hint: As in WinSCP: the first word is the BUCKET, not a folder inside it. prod-s3-nwd means the whole bucket; prod-s3-nwd/exports means the “exports” folder in it. How this was understood is written on the line below — check it before saving.
s3_remove_confirm: Remove connection “{p1}” from the settings? Already downloaded files will stay on disk, and so will the secret — it can be forgotten with a separate button.
s3_run_hint: The s3-sync command with this name does the same. The program will fetch what is new, remove what it brought earlier and is no longer in the bucket, and will not touch foreign files in the folder, but will name them.
s3_secret_hint: The secret is stored separately, by Windows means, under your account — it is not in the settings file and the program never shows it back. Leave the field empty if you are changing everything else: the saved secret is then not touched.
s3_sub: The program downloads files from the bucket into a folder on this computer — the same way WinSCP does. After that everything is as usual: the report reads that same folder. The fields below are the same as in the WinSCP connection window.
s3_target_hint: A folder on this computer — the same one you choose in the report. Press “Browse…” so you do not have to type the path by hand.
s3_test_truncated: Not everything is shown — there are more objects than the program looks at during a check.
s3_title: S3 bucket as a network folder
scenario_hint: A scenario is the same report with a different set of input files: “the same, but without Irkutsk”, “plan B”. The copy is made from this set, and after that it can be edited separately.
state_missing: there is nothing at this path
subtitle: This records which folders on this computer the program reads files from for each report. Paths are not sent anywhere by themselves — only the platform sees them, and only after a run.
title: Report folders
